Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 114
, Reason for Mistake: After reaching the termination condition, the Orchestrator allowed a fabricated final answer (“5:30 PM”) to be produced without any supporting evidence or source. Despite extensive web searches, no passenger-count data or specific schedule tying “most passengers” to a particular train on May 27, 2019 was found. The Orchestrator should have reported insufficient information or pursued verifiable sources rather than concluding with an unsupported time.
